== Build notes: 2008 MPC consolation result and source check ==

Added eighth place in the Sunday consolation event from the numbered final standings, dated 6 January 2008 and using [[Premiere - Original VS14]].<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation results], Players Committee Forums.</ref> No dropped marker is listed. Existing tournament rows, deck links and card credits are retained. The source catalogue heading is now External links.

The existing 2009 Worlds Day 2 row cited a general forum index. Moved that general index to External links and cited the original decklist PDF directly: page 31 names Mike French, marks Dark, says Day 2 and 10 October 2009, and begins with Hunt Down.<ref>[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D2.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 2 decklists], p. 31.</ref> The existing 2008 Worlds row likewise cited the general awards page, which does not name Mike. Moved that general link to External links and cited page 13 of the original 2008 Day 2 PDF; it names Mike French, marks Dark, says Worlds Day 2 and starts with Carbon Chamber Testing.<ref>[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2008/Worlds/2008+Worlds+D2.pdf 2008 Worlds Day 2 decklists], p. 13.</ref> The original PDF URLs were streamed and hash-matched to the independently backed native copy; this is an observed identity, not a filename-based assumption. The related forum thread's first page does not name Mike and was not treated as participation proof.

The public source payloads, exact drafts and live revisions have independent backups and central preservation records. Raw browser observations containing transient session fields remain local; public derivatives omit session/contact fields while preserving all other source text.
